jobs.description_text: This role sits within NCS AI Central's (AIC) Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model — the combined capability that takes AI solutions from proof-of-concept through to hardened production systems. As Fullstack Developer, you build both the frontend and backend of Gen AI applications — from UI through API and cloud deployment — operating across both fast-moving FDE engagements (POC/POV, pilot deployments) and steady-state system development and maintenance work. What will you do: 1. Frontend Development Build a simple, clean UI to support key POC and application workflows (upload, query, view results), using ReactJS. Implement screens with usable UX, optimised for performance and cross-device compatibility. Integrate with backend APIs for model inference, RAG results, and agentic workflow status and outputs. Handle user inputs, file uploads, and display model/agent outputs responsively — accounting for the multi-step, non-deterministic nature of agentic workflows. Add lightweight feedback/error handling for API failures or delayed responses; implement basic authentication or access control where required. 2. Backend Development Design and develop backend services and APIs using Python (FastAPI/Flask) to support Gen AI functionality. Implement endpoints for model inference requests, RAG workflows, agentic workflow orchestration (e.g. using frameworks such as AWS Strands or LangGraph), and document upload/processing/storage. Integrate with cloud AI services for inference and model orchestration — AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI depending on the engagement — including China-origin models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) where self-hosted or exposed via compatible endpoints. Build lightweight pipelines for RAG (chunking, embeddings, retrieval). Apply LLMOps practices to support model monitoring and versioning as applications mature toward production. Manage data storage using Postgres (RDS or equivalent) and/or vector search services (OpenSearch, FAISS, or cloud-native equivalents). 3. Deployment & Quality Containerise applications using Docker and deploy to AWS ECS Fargate/Lambda, Azure Container Apps/Functions, GCP Cloud Run, or equivalent Kubernetes-based services (EKS/AKS/GKE) where required. Implement CI/CD pipelines for rapid iteration, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CDK) where practical. Perform code scans and reviews to identify security issues early (e.g. SonarQube, Fortify). 4. FDE & Development/Maintenance Coverage During FDE engagements: prioritise speed, clarity, and flexibility over perfect design, iterating quickly based on user feedback and validation sessions. During system development & maintenance engagements: harden the same application into production-grade code, with full CI/CD, monitoring, and security scanning in place. 5. Collaboration Work closely with the Application Architect and Cloud Engineer/Architect to align API contracts and architecture. Document API contracts, workflows, and deployment/UI steps for the team. Role Levels We Are Hiring For We are hiring at two levels for this role. All responsibilities above apply to both; the distinction is in scope of ownership, years of experience, and seniority of judgement expected. Fullstack Developer – AI Applications 2–4 years of relevant experience. Builds frontend and backend features for one engagement at a time, under guidance from a Senior Fullstack Developer or Application Architect. Executes defined API/UI work; escalates architecture-level design decisions to the Application Architect. Senior Fullstack Developer – AI Applications 5+ years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years hands-on in AI/Gen AI application development. Owns fullstack delivery across more complex engagements and works more independently with the Application Architect on design decisions. Mentors junior Fullstack Developers and sets implementation patterns others follow. The ideal candidate should possess: Strong in ReactJS, basic state management (Context, Redux, or simple React Query), and TypeScript. Strong Python development experience (FastAPI/Flask). Experience with REST APIs, JSON, and async handling. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud AI service (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI), including model integration, orchestration, and prompt handling. Working knowledge of China-origin models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) a plus. Familiarity with agentic orchestration frameworks such as AWS Strands or LangGraph, for implementing multi-step agent workflows. Familiar with file upload handling (PDF, DOCX, text). Containerization experience (Docker) and deployment to at least one major cloud's container/serverless services; familiarity with Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) is a plus. Familiarity with Postgres schema design, querying, and managed database setup. Comfortable building lightweight RAG and agentic pipelines and integrating with vector stores. Understand how Gen AI and agentic outputs can vary and need dynamic rendering. Working knowledge of secure coding practices and code scanning tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience with OpenSearch Serverless, Azure AI Search, or other vector databases. Familiarity with event-driven architectures (SQS/SNS/EventBridge or Azure/GCP equivalents). Basic knowledge of prompt engineering and Gen AI output evaluation. Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform). Exposure to Singapore Government GCC/HCC environments. Tech Stack (Illustrative) Languages: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript Frontend: ReactJS, Redux Backend: FastAPI/Flask Platform: Docker, AWS ECS Fargate/Lambda, Azure Container Apps/Functions, GCP Cloud Run, EKS/AKS/GKE (as needed) LLM Runtime: AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, AWS Strands/LangGraph; DeepSeek/Qwen/GLM (China stack) Storage/Search: Postgres (RDS or equivalent), OpenSearch, FAISS CI/CD: Terraform/CDK, standard pipelines Code Quality: SonarQube, Fortify Why Join NCS Lead high-impact AI management consulting programs for major enterprises and public sector clients. jobs.description_text: Join NCS as a Senior LLM / Multimodal AI Engineer and spearhead the development of next-generation foundation models and multimodal understanding systems. With 4+ years of hands-on experience, you will architect, train, evaluate, and deploy large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) that process billions of user-generated content (UGC) and advertising videos. You will transform cutting-edge research into industrial-scale recommendation and advertising systems that deliver measurable business impact. What will you do? Data Curation & Multimodal Pre-Training Architect and scale automated data pipelines that integrate video frames, images, OCR, ASR, and text for VLM pre-training and fine-tuning Drive LLM-assisted annotation workflows and synthetic data generation strategies to minimise manual labeling overhead Engineer robust data quality frameworks ensuring representative, accurate, and complete training datasets Model Training & Fine-Tuning Reproduce and optimise foundation model series (e.g., LLaVA, Qwen-VL family) for production environments Execute supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and post-training for domain-specific content ecosystems including gaming, movies, automotive, and commercial advertising Implement advanced training techniques including PEFT, LoRA, and quantization-aware training Multimodal RAG & Knowledge Bases Design and deploy hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that enrich video understanding and enable in-context retrieval Build scalable vector search indexes (e.g., FAISS) supporting billions of embeddings Optimise retrieval strategies including hybrid search, re-ranking, and query expansion Inference Optimization & Deployment Optimise large-scale VLM and LLM serving using vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, and ONNX Runtime Implement dynamic batching, feature caching, and asynchronous scheduling to maximise GPU throughput Monitor and tune production inference systems for latency, cost, and quality trade-offs Evaluation & Agent Workflows Establish comprehensive online/offline evaluation benchmarks measuring generative quality, aesthetic completeness, and vertical task precision/recall Contribute to intelligent tag platform agents and agentic workflow orchestration Conduct continuous LLM-as-Judge evaluation on production traces An Ideal Candidate Should Possess: Experience 4+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning system development, with demonstrated focus on NLP, Computer Vision, LLMs, or Multimodal AI Proven track record of independently driving end-to-end ML initiatives from research exploration to high-throughput production deployment Core Technical Skills Deep expertise in deep learning fundamentals, transformer architectures, and multimodal fusion techniques Proficiency in deep learning frameworks: PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem, DeepSpeed, PEFT, LlamaFactory Strong programming capabilities in Python, SQL, Spark, and Linux/Git workflows Hands-on experience with vector search and retrieval infrastructure (FAISS, Multimodal RAG) Familiarity with LLM/VLM serving and quantization toolkits (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton) Preferred Qualifications Industrial experience in large-scale recommender systems, advertising technology, or content moderation/understanding ecosystems Hands-on expertise with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or preference optimization (e.g., DPO, GRPO) Published research or competitive achievements in top AI/ML venues or challenges (e.g., CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR, Kaggle) Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI) Knowledge of AI observability tools (Langfuse, Weights & Biases, MLflow) Collaborate with NCS At NCS, you'll work alongside cross-functional teams including AI Solution Architects, Data Engineers, and Product specialists to deliver transformative multimodal AI solutions.
